import os
from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-72a05467.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    halfturn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + halfturn[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)

demo_in=[[6,8,8,5],[8,8,1,8],[5,2,8,8],[1,5,1,8]]
demo_out=[[6,8,8,5,1,5,8,6],[8,8,1,8,5,2,8,8],[5,2,8,8,1,8,1,8],[1,5,1,8,8,8,8,5],[5,8,8,8,8,1,5,1],[8,1,8,1,8,8,2,5],[8,8,2,5,8,1,8,8],[6,8,5,1,5,8,8,6]]
# Load the saved program and validate against received demo.
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_72a05467', program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
result=mod.transform(demo_in)
print('demo_match', result==demo_out, 'dims',len(result),len(result[0]))
